title: Hermit Permits
start: Read the village noticeboard in Wendlewick.

recommended.t: Runes for multiple casts of Wendlewick Teleport

rewards.t: Snippers, a feet slot cosmetic override

steps.t: Read the Village Noticeboard in Wendlewick, just north of the pub. [Chat: 4 HELP NEEDED! Crabs running amok. › Accept]

Talk to Grocer Hannah in the Wendlewick food shop, east of the bank. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Hermit Permits'. › Any › 1 I could try herding them out? › 2 What if I threatened them? › 3 I could just kill them all.]
Talk to Shelly, the crab, located in the same store and on the floor.
Follow the crab, talking to it every time it stops.
Enter the cave to the east and talk to Hermit inside to the north-west.
Kill one of the crabs for a fresh crab claw, craft it into an crab amulet (unstrung), and use it on a ball of wool to make a crab amulet.
Equip the crabulet and talk to Shelly.
Return to Wendlewick, go back to the food shop, and talk to Shelly.
South of the Shrine of Inanna, go to the beach and talk to any of the crabs (Finn, Sandy, or Kai).

sub.t: (Optional) Travel via the canoe station [Chat: 3 Wendlewick (Grotto)] on the dock next to the Burnt Lobster Tavern and then go south-west.

steps.t: Return to Wendlewick and talk to Adam (in the northern building). [Chat: ? Talk about 'Hermit Permits'.]
Talk to Zeke in the building to the east. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Hermit Permits'.]
Talk to Esther upstairs in the lighthouse. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Hermit Permits'.]
Talk to 5 different villagers around Wendlewick to get them to sign the planning permission form. The shop and stall owners work for this. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Hermit Permits'.]
Talk to either Adam, Esther, or Zeke again. [Chat: # Talk about 'Hermit Permits'.]
Go back to the southern beach and talk to one of the crab leaders.

sub.t: 6 seaweed can be collected to the west on the same beach.
You also need to bring 3 ropes. If you have the Lorehound pet quest supplies track unlocked you can obtain from there.

steps.t: Build the three piles of driftwood on the beach into their huts.
Talk to Finn, Sandy, or Kai.
